rules.sentence: Primary psychotic disorder is generally synonymous with auditory hallucinations, whereas psychosis associated with medical/neurologic conditions is usually associated with all other types of hallucinations except auditory (e.g., visual, tactile, olfactory).
A proper medical workup, along with a psychiatric evaluation, is always warranted.
As discussed, there is a myriad of underlying causes for a patient presenting with a psychotic episode, including a primary psychiatric disorder, substance-induced, neurologic, or medical induced.
